description: Today, Michael Whatley hosted a Make More, Keep More press conference in Greensboro where he highlighted how Cooper’s far-left policies made life more expensive for North Carolina families. Under Cooper’s watch energy costs skyrocketed 30%, housing costs went up by 85%, and healthcare costs rose to the highest in the country. North Carolina business owners joined Whatley to address how Roy Cooper raised costs on their businesses and made it harder to operate a business in North Carolina.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Whatley for Senate
title: Michael Whatley Hosts Make More, Keep More Press Conference in Greensboro – Michael Whatley for Senate
